name: Risk of Rain 2
rules: You must play on Eclipse 8 for the hardest diffculty.
extra_information: Do not use the Alloyed Collective mod as it may mess with Archipelago due to not being supported yet.

name: ULTRAKILL

name: CloverPit
rules: Do not use CloverPitAPHints, as it is broken and makes the game easier. Any other mods are fine, as long as the game is not made easier from them.
extra_information: If you own it, disable the Unholy Fusion DLC, as it's not yet supported in the version we are using.
